name: Alchemy Training
description:
You know your way around brewing potions and can do the simple types by heart.
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Alchemy Lore increases (max Expert).
Each morning you can make two temporary potions.
For each potion you prepare you lock away 1 mana from your mana well for the day, and the potions expire at the end of the day.
The potions can be Lesser Health Potions, Lesser Mana Potions or Lesser Elemental Resistance Potions.

name: Apprentice Spellcraft
description:
You've studied spells here and there, picking up any that seemed interesting.
You learn 2 + your INT apprentice spells of your choosing.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Attunement ShortcutTest
description:
Your attunement lets you learn spells that would normally be too advanced for you.
Learn two attuned spells of the spells of the rank above this feats level.
Before you could cast them normally, you need to spend a focus point when you cast these spells due to their complexity.

name: Aura Hardening
description:
Your aura is tougher and you are trained in using it for defense.
When you use Aura Block, reduce the damage by your WIL.
Your proficiency level in Will saves increases (max Trained).

name: Aura Reinforcement
description:
You have trained your aura and can reinforce it faster.
When you use the Reinforce Aura action you can spend mana up to 3 times your level + your WIL.
You can also raise and lower your aura as a single action.

name: Basic Elemental Magic
description:
Your skills with one aspect of magic have grown.
Choose one aspect and learn two apprentice rank spells from that aspect.
You gain a bonus depending on the aspect.
You can choose this feat multiple times, once for each aspect.

name: Focused Spellshaping
description:
You've trained with complex spells that take longer to cast.
You have a +1 bonus to spellshaping checks when casting spells that cost 3 actions or more.
Learn two apprentice spells that cost 3 actions or more.

name: Gadget Crafting
description:
You've trained to craft gadgets that provide different benefits.
Your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Expert).
Each morning you can make two temporary gadgets.
The gadgets break apart after the day and only work for you (unless specified).
You can choose this feat multiple times, letting you craft two more gadgets each time.

name: Knowledge Is Power
description:
Knowing how a spell works allows you to move to its edges and weak points.
When you make saving throws against spells you know, or spells you successfully identify, you may add half your INT to the saving throw.

name: Metamagic Novice
description:
You've studied metamagics, ways of modifying spells you cast.
You learn 2 + your INT metamagics.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Monster Hunting
description:
You are trained in Monster Hunting Lore, which can be used to Recall Knowledge against monsters and elementals.
When you succeed on a Recall Knowledge check with Monster Hunting Lore, the creature takes a -2 penalty to the next save you impose on it.
You learn the Combat Assessment technique.

name: Physical Sort
description:
You have forgone some of your arcane training to focus on the practical. 
Gain one level 1 General Feats.

name: Runed Ammo
description:
You can inscribe runes in mundane ammunition.
Your proficiency level with Crafting increases (max Expert).
Each morning you can inscribe 5 pieces of mundane ammunition — arrows, crossbow bolts, runegun ammo or sling stones — with magic.
You can make them into:
Disruptor Ammo - If it hits a target's aura, their aura gains 2 weakness to all damage until the end of your next turn.
Tracer Rounds - On a hit, the target glows. It has a -3 penalty to Stealth checks until the end of your next turn.
Incendiary Ammo - The attack deals an extra 1d4 fire damage, but reduces the weapon damage die by 2 (1d8 to 1d6 for example).
Heavy Rounds - On a hit the target becomes off-guard 1 until the end of your next turn. You have -1 range when attacking with these.
You can give the ammo to others, though the runes fade at the end of the day.

name: Siphon Mana
description:
You've learned to reuse magic from failed spells.
You learn the Siphon Mana action, which you can use if your last action was a failed spellshaping check.
Your proficiency level in Channeling or Mana Sensing increases (max Expert).

name: Spellblade
description:
You are trained in using magic and weaponry together.
When a creature fails or critically fails a save against one of your spells, it takes a -2 penalty to saves against your strikes for the rest of the turn.
When you hit a creature with a Strike, it takes a -2 penalty to saves against your spells for the rest of the turn.

name: Spellcraft Scholar
description:
A scholar in magic, you don't just know how to cast spells, but why they work.
Your proficiency level in Arcana increases (max Expert).
You have a +2 bonus to identify spells.
Learn one Apprentice Spell.

name: Studied Ahead
description:
You have studied ahead to get to the cool spells.
Learn two spells without the Complex trait of the spells of the rank above this feats level.
Before level 4, you need to spend a focus point when you cast these spells due to their complexity.

name: Tools of the Trade
description:
You've learned a few tricks to vary your magic.
You learn one apprentice rank spell.
You learn one metamagic.
Your proficiency level with Arcana, Crafting, Channeling, Mana Sensing, Alchemy Lore, Soul Lore or Dimensionalism Lore increases (max Trained).
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Extend Aura
description:
You have learned to protect others with your aura.
You have the Extend Aura reaction.

name: Mana Thread
description:
You've figured out how to draw a thread of mana to a target, allowing you to target them with magic at a range.
You have the Draw Mana Thread action.

name: Adept Elemental Magic
description:
Your experience in one aspect of magic grows.
Choose one aspect and learn two adept rank spells from that aspect.
You become Expert in casting spells of your chosen aspect.
You can choose this feat multiple times, once for each aspect.
prerequisites: [Basic Elemental Magic], for the same aspect

name: Adept Spellcraft
description:
Adept spells bring more facets of magic and more potent spells.
You learn 2 + your INT adept spells of your choosing.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Armor Artificer
description:
You have constructed an enchanted suit of armor, designed for you specifically.
You can choose between Leather Laminar, Half Plate and Full Plate.
You are trained in this armor and can ignore its PHY requirements.
It has Anti Tampering runes, preventing it from being affected by hostile magic, and can be improved by future feats.
Your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Master).

name: Artificer's Weapon
description:
You create a custom weapon powered through artifice.
It is a Whip Sword, Powered Hammer or a pair of Impact Gauntlets.
You are trained in the weapon.
It has Anti Tampering runes, preventing it from being affected by hostile magic, and can be improved by future feats.
Your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Master).

name: Combat Mana Threads
description:
Whether with a strike or a spell, you know how to attach mana threads in combat.
After you succeed on an unarmed melee Strike, you can spend an action to attach a mana thread without making a check.
You learn the Tracing Spell metamagic.
Your proficiency level in Channeling increases (max Master).

name: Elemental Aura
description:
You've learned to infuse elemental magic into your aura.
You learn the Elemental Aura action, which you can use with any aspect you have Basic Elemental Magic for.

name: Enhancement Brewer
description:
You've learned to make enhancement potions to temporarily enhance your and your allies' abilities.
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Alchemy Lore increases (max Master).
You can make Yeti's Strength, Griffin's Agility, Drake's Cunning and Diratheen's Will potions as temporary potions.

name: Golem Upgrade
description:
You've tinkered with your golem to upgrade it.
Add one golem upgrade to it.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Incanter's Stance
description:
You've learned how to enter a stance where you put all your focus on your magic, ignoring the outside world.
You have the Incanter's Stance action.

name: Manafuel Aura
description:
You've learned how to infuse some of the mana from spells into your aura.
If you use the Reinforce Aura action after casting a spell, you may add twice the spell's rank worth of mana to your aura for free.

name: Metamagic Adept
description:
Your skills in metamagics have grown, allowing you to use multiple on a single spell.
You learn three metamagics of your choice.
You may use two metamagics on a single spell.

name: Overload Golem
description:
You've learned how to put some extra power into your Golem.
At the start of your turn you can choose to give your Golem an action for the turn.
After using this ability your golem takes 1d4 vital damage and is stunned 2 next turn as it overloads the runework.
You can also use this ability on other allied golems by making a Golem Lore or Crafting check.

name: Quick Tinkerer
description:
You can quickly modify gadgets for when the situation changes.
Your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Master).
Increase the amount of gadgets you can craft each day by 2.
You may spend 1 minute turning one crafted gadget into another gadget.

name: Runegun Smith
description:
You have created a runegun of your own design that you are proficient with and can modify.
Your proficiency level with Runeguns increases (max Expert).
It is a runegun rifle, sharpshot, pistol or cannon.
It has an Anti Tampering rune.
Your proficiency level in Crafting increases (max Expert).

name: Runegun Upgrade
description:
You've upgraded your Runegun.
Pick a Runegun Upgrade.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Sensing Threads
description:
Through your mana threads you can sense enemies' weaknesses and detect when they are about to cast spells.
You can use Channeling to Recall Knowledge on weaknesses and abilities of creatures in your Mana Threads.
When creatures in your Mana Threads cast spells, you have a +1 bonus on saving throws against them.
Your proficiency level in Channeling increases (max Master).

name: Spellbreaking
description:
You have studied the art of Spellbreaking, tearing apart spells before they get formed. 
You learn the Spellbreak reaction.

name: Stabilize Spell
description:
When you fail at spellcasting you can put some extra effort in to stabilize it.
You learn the Stabilize Spell reaction.

name: Threaded Spellbreak
description:
You can perform Spellbreaking through your mana threads.
You can use the Spellbreak reaction from any of your Mana Threads.
If the caster of the spell is the target of your thread, you have a +2 bonus to the Spellbreak roll and recover mana equal to the rank of the spell on a successful Spellbreak.

name: Absorb Mana
description:
You have experience sensing and harnessing mana, allowing you to get more mana faster.
Your proficiency level in Mana Sensing increases (max Master).
When you harness mana you can choose to increase the DC by 5 to gain one more die.
If you are Master in Mana Sensing you can increase the DC by 10 to get two more dice, and if you are Legendary you can increase the DC by 15 for three more dice of mana.

name: Double Runegun
description:
You've made another runegun.
You have another custom Runegun, which can be the same type as your main one or different.
They both get upgrades from the Runegun Upgrade feats; those upgrades can be the same or different.

name: Enchanter
description:
You've trained with spells that enhance your or others' physical abilities.
You become Expert in casting spells with the Enhancement trait.
If you get a critical success on spellshaping a spell with the Enhancement trait, you recover mana equal to its rank.

name: Evoker
description:
You've trained with spells that hit a wide area.
Your proficiency level in spells with the Area trait increases (max Expert).
Learn the Expand Spell metamagic, or another level 1 metamagic if you already know that one.
The Expand Spell metamagic doesn't count to the limits of metamagics you can use when casting Area spells.

name: Expand Aura
description:
You can now expand your aura to protect your allies from a distance. 
You learn the Expand Aura action.

name: Expanded Soulsight
description:
With some practice observing souls, the range you can use your soulsight on expands.
Increase the range of your Inspect Soul action to 7 tiles.
Your proficiency level in Soul Lore increases (max Master).

name: Incanter's Flow
description:
Using Incanter's Stance you've figured out how to weave spells into one another.
When you cast a spell in Incanter's Stance and your last action was to cast another spell, you may spend a focus point to reduce its action cost by 1.

name: Master Tinker
description:
You have gadgets for every situation.
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Arcana increases (max Master).
Increase the amount of gadgets you can craft each day by 3.

name: Multi-Aspect Mastery
description:
Your skills extend to all aspects of magic.
You count as having the Basic Elemental Magic feat for all aspects of magic.
Learn 3 Apprentice and 3 Adept rank spells, all from different aspects.
prerequisites: [Basic Elemental Magic], for two different aspects

name: Reactive Spell
description:
You cast spells so quickly you can hit creatures as they move past you.
You learn the Reactive Spell reaction

name: Reinforce Elemental Aura
description:
Using the energy of your spells, you can maintain your elemental aura without effort.
When you use Elemental Aura and cast a spell of the same aspect as the aura, you may Sustain the aura as a free action for no cost.

name: Remote Activation
description:
You can activate magical devices at range using your mana threads.
You can attach mana threads to objects and activate magical devices at range.
If you have a mana thread attached to a creature, you can activate gadgets and runeguns they are carrying by making a Channeling roll against 10 + their Crafting.
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Channeling increases (max Master).

name: Spell Sharpshooter
description:
You're good at spells that target foes at range.
You become Expert in casting spells with the Attack trait.
When casting spells with the Targeting trait you increase their range by 3 tiles.

name: Steal Attuned Spell
description:
When others attempt to use spells of your attunement, you can take control.
You have the Steal Attuned Spell action.

name: Compress Spell
description:
Your dimensionalism studies have led to a way to compress spells in "dimensional bubbles" and keep them for later.
You learn the Compress Spell metamagic, ignoring its normal level requirement.
Your proficiency level in Arcana or Channeling increases (max Master).

name: Ethereal Threads
description:
Your mana threads are more durable and can go through objects.
Your mana threads have a max range of 12 tiles and no longer break if the target has full cover, as they phase through matter.
Solid Adamantium and special wards may still block your threads.
Your proficiency level in Channeling increases (max Master).

name: Forceful Spellbreaking
description:
By pouring more mana into the Spellbreaking you've learned to amplify your chances.
When you attempt to break a spell you may spend mana equal to its full cost.
If you do, add your WIL to the Spellbreaking check.

name: Magus Spellcraft
description:
Magus spells bring dimensionalism and soul magic, as well as enough power to serve as staples for battlemages
You learn 2 + your INT magus spells of your choosing.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Spellcasting Savant
description:
Complex spells aren't as complicated as some say. At least for you.
The Complex trait only increases the spellshaping DC by 2 for you (instead of 3).
You learn 3 magus spells.

name: Teleportation Expertise
description:
You're a master at teleporting yourself and others.
When you cast a spell with the Teleportation trait, increase its range by 2 tiles.
Your proficiency level in spells with Teleportation increases (max Expert).
Your proficiency level in Arcana or Dimensionalism Lore increases (max Master)

name: Expert Caster
description:
Your magical expertise makes it easier to cast any spell.
Your proficiency level with all spells you know is at least Expert.

name: Improved Design
description:
You've improved your golem's skillset.
All of its proficiency levels increase (max Expert).
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Arcana increases (max Master).

name: Master of Many Magics
description:
You have practiced many types of magic. 
Gain three level 4 or lower Arcane Feats.
unlockedFeats: Arcane Feat - Level 4, Arcane Feat - Level 4, Arcane Feat - Level 4

name: Rapid Spellbreak
description:
Spellbreaking comes naturally to you, and you do it as swiftly as the wind.
You have one additional reaction per round, which you may only use to Spellbreak or Identify Spell.

name: Strengthened Elemental Aura
description:
When you use your Elemental Aura you may strengthen it.
This doubles the mana cost to infuse it and sustain it, but increases any resistances it provides by 5 and makes it deal an additional die of damage.

name: Master Enchanter
description:
Enhancement spells become second nature to you and you can strengthen them to speed up allies.
Your proficiency level with Enhancement spells increases (max Master).
Creatures (including you) affected by your Enhancement spells may spend a focus point at the start of their turn to become Hastened 1 for that turn.

name: Master Evoker
description:
Your spells can devastate all large areas.
Your proficiency level with Area spells increases (max Master).
When you cast Area spells you may increase the size of their damage dice by 1 (d8 to d10, etc.).

name: Master Spellslinger
description:
Your spellslinging skills are renowned.
Your proficiency level with Attack spells increases (max Master).
Attack spells have the Agile trait for you.

name: Grand Magus Spellcraft
description:
Grand Magus spells have enough power to devastate cities, and the finesse to transmute living creatures.
You learn 2 + your INT grand magus spells of your choosing.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Metamagic Master
description:
Modifying spells comes naturally to you.
You learn four metamagics of your choice.
You may use any amount of metamagics on a single spell, taking a -1 penalty for each one beyond 3.

name: Master of Threads
description:
With your mana threads you can ensure no one escapes your spells.
You learn the Hold By Thread action.
Your proficiency level in Channeling increases (max Legendary).

name: Masterwork Golem
description:
Your golem has no imperfections.
All of its proficiency levels increase (max Master).
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Arcana increases (max Legendary).

name: Archmage Spellcraft
description:
Archmage spells bring the greatest magic most people see in their lives.
You learn 2 + your INT archmage spells of your choosing.
You can choose this feat multiple times.

name: Detonate Spell
description:
You do not just disrupt spells, you detonate them.
When you attempt a Spellbreak, you can spend a focus point to attempt to detonate the spell.
On a success you detonate the spell in a burst of mana.
The caster and adjacent creatures must make a PHY save or take 1d8 unraveling damage per rank of the spell.
Creatures that fail the save also suffer one level of mana poisoning, or two on a critical failure.
You cannot get back any mana or other resources from Spellbreaking when you do this.

name: Signature Spell
description:
You've mastered a spell beyond any other.
Your proficiency level with a spell increases (max Legendary).
You may enhance that spell in some way (Talk with your DM, roughly equivalent to upcasting it one level).
You may use one extra metamagic when casting that spell.

name: Archmage's Versatility
description:
You have a renowned ability to cast spells of different types with masterful precision.
Your proficiency level with all spells you know is at least Master.

name: Legendary Evoker
description:
Bring forth devastation.
Your proficiency level with Area spells increases (max Legendary).
You learn the Expand Spell metamagic and can use it without modifying spell DCs.
You can spend a focus point to reroll the damage of an Area spell (as many times as you want).

name: Legendary Golemsmith
description:
Your golem will be studied for generations.
All of its proficiency levels increase (max Legendary).
Your proficiency level in Crafting or Arcana increases (max Legendary).
